requirements.title: A processor may evaluate an equivalent expression for an established defined operation if parentheses integrity is preserved
requirements.definition: Once the interpretation of a defined operation is established, the processor has latitude to evaluate another equivalent expression, but only when the integrity of parentheses is not violated.

pending.established-interpretation-precondition: PENDING source-only plan that first establishes defined-operation interpretation through a valid 10.1.6.1 interface before discussing any equivalent-expression latitude; invalid or ambiguous generic interfaces are excluded.
pending.equivalent-expression-evaluation-latitud: PENDING permission record only: future tests may not require the processor to choose or avoid an equivalent expression. Positive controls must accept every result permitted by the defining operation and parentheses integrity.
pending.parentheses-integrity-not-violated: PENDING boundary plan using a non-associative defined operation to show that expressions whose parenthesisations produce different derived values are not interchangeable under this permission.
pending.no-processor-strategy-oracle: PENDING negative-oracle guard documenting that call counts, operand evaluation order, short-circuit behavior, emitted code, and floating-point reassociation observations are not evidence for or against this permission.

requirements.oracle: This is a processor permission, not a required behavior. No future plan may assert that a processor did or did not exercise the latitude; plans may only avoid false oracles and test requirements that remain invariant under all permitted equivalent evaluations.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This source-only catalogue records pending plans only. It creates no Fortran test program, invokes no processor, approves no fixture or oracle, and claims no coverage. Future cases must not infer which operand was evaluated, the order of evaluation, or whether an optional evaluation was omitted; must not assert a result that a permitted mathematically or logically equivalent rewrite could change; must not use floating-point tolerance as an escape hatch; must not rely on compiler agreement, address arithmetic, TRANSFER, emitted assembly, or undefined reads; and must attribute every negative to the cited requirement rather than to an independently invalid rule owned elsewhere.

requirements.title: Derived-type expression equivalence requires equal values for all possible primary values
requirements.definition: For expressions of derived type, equivalence means that the expressions have equal values for every possible assignment of values to their primaries. A difference for any possible primary values establishes non-equivalence.

pending.derived-type-expression-equivalence: PENDING source-only definition plan for derived-type expressions whose equivalence is considered only after their values are defined by applicable operations and types.
pending.equal-values-for-all-primaries: PENDING mathematical/source review plan requiring equality for all possible values of primaries; finite execution samples cannot by themselves prove this universal condition.
pending.sampled-values-not-a-proof: PENDING oracle limitation for future evidence: literal samples may refute equivalence when they differ, but may not establish all-primary equivalence without a separate source proof.
pending.nonassociative-defined-operation-non-equ: PENDING derived-type operator plan with result component left%v*10+right%v and operands 1,2,3; differing values for (a op b) op c and a op (b op c) refute equivalence and therefore block a rewrite across the parentheses boundary.

requirements.oracle: Future controls may use a non-associative defined operation to refute equivalence by producing two parenthesised expressions with independently computed unequal values. They must not claim universal equivalence from finite compiler executions.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This source-only catalogue records pending plans only. It creates no Fortran test program, invokes no processor, approves no fixture or oracle, and claims no coverage. review_rationale: batch103: independent fresh-context source review against pinned J3/24-007 (sha256 7371e889...). Reviewer read all 20 base units of 10.1.6.1, 10.1.6.2, 10.1.6.3, 10.1.7 and 10.1.8 in the original PDF rather than the author summary, verified 20 base / 56 fine units, 10 requirements and 63 facets (all pending), and separately re-read the 10.1.2.4, 10.1.2.6, 10.1.2.8 and 10.1.2.9 grammar units to confirm ownership. A global name-head check over 502 rule heads found 0 missing, 0 duplicate and 0 unmatched, and confirmed the defined-operator grammar owners remain R1004/C1005, R1024/C1006, R1012, R1020 and R1022. Every processor freedom is correctly recorded as a permission: 10.1.6.3 p1 equivalent-expression latitude is bounded by parenthesis integrity, 10.1.7 p1 records that a processor need not evaluate all operands or evaluate each entirely, and 10.1.8 p1 keeps the rewrite context as permission while preserving the normative requirement that a parenthesized expression be treated as a data entity. 10.1.7 p3 is the single restriction in scope, with its CRITICAL and END CRITICAL exceptions. This packet carries four delegations left open by earlier batches: defined-binary applicability and generic nonapplicability from 10.1.2.9, and the left-recursive grouping facets from 10.1.2.6 and 10.1.2.8, which are discharged through a value-observable non-associative defined extension rather than through truth tables, short-circuiting or side effects. Undefined-status effects are recorded as not value-observable by reading the entity, and finite samples are recorded as able to refute but never to prove the all-possible-primary-values equivalence of 10.1.6.3 p2. Decision: accept, no blocking findings; three non-blocking observations recorded in doc/source_audits/batch_103.json. This registers source accounting only: it is not fixture approval, it supplies no execution, and it approves no oracle.
